officialDocs.label: Get started with eBay APIs (keysets, growth check)

verdict.summary: For Sell APIs (orders, inventory, listings) it's self-serve: a developer account approved in about a business day, a production keyset activated once you subscribe to or opt out of account-deletion notifications, and any seller can then grant consent. The catches are default daily call limits (5,000/day in eBay's example) until you pass the free Application Growth Check, and Buy APIs, which are limited to eBay partners.

evidence.label: sourced
evidence.note: eBay says account approval takes approximately 1 business day; sandbox keysets and RuName setup follow in under an hour.

timeToProd.assumes: An agent that reads and writes a seller's orders and listings through Sell APIs at modest volume; higher call limits or restricted APIs need an Application Growth Check, and Buy APIs need eBay Partner Network approval.
timeToProd.waitingOn: Developer account approval (~1 business day) and the account-deletion notification endpoint challenge (or opt-out) that activates the production keyset.

steps.title: Register for the eBay Developers Program
steps.detail: Submit the registration form and wait for account approval.

steps.title: Create sandbox and production keysets
steps.detail: Application Keys → Create a keyset under Sandbox and under Production; each gives an App ID (client_id) and Cert ID (client_secret).

steps.title: Build the account-deletion notification endpoint
steps.detail: Handle eBay's GET challenge by returning 200 with challengeResponse = SHA-256(challengeCode + verificationToken + endpoint) as JSON, and acknowledge POSTed deletion notifications with 2xx.

steps.title: Subscribe to (or opt out of) deletion notifications
steps.detail: In Alerts & Notifications set the HTTPS endpoint and a 32–80 character verification token and Save, or opt out only if you don't persist eBay data. This activates the production keyset.

steps.title: Set up the RuName
steps.detail: On the User Tokens page (/my/auth) create an OAuth-enabled RuName and set the Auth Accepted and Declined URLs to your HTTPS callback.

steps.title: Implement the authorization code flow
steps.detail: Redirect to https://auth.ebay.com/oauth2/authorize with client_id, redirect_uri=<RuName>, response_type=code and space-separated scopes; exchange the code at https://api.ebay.com/identity/v1/oauth2/token with Basic auth and redirect_uri=<RuName>.

steps.title: Test with sandbox users
steps.detail: Consent with a sandbox eBay account and confirm the agent can read orders.

steps.title: Monitor call usage
steps.detail: Track daily usage (App Settings & Insight in the developer portal) and design for the default daily call limit.

evidence.label: inferred
evidence.note: KB 1362 links usage insight from the portal; exact tooling is our reading.

steps.title: Apply for the Application Growth Check if needed
steps.detail: Activate developer support and submit the App Growth Check form in My Account for higher limits or restricted APIs.

steps.title: Growth Check review
steps.detail: eBay checks API License Agreement compliance and efficient API use.

blockers.symptom: Production keyset shown as disabled / Non Compliant
blockers.cause: The marketplace account deletion/closure notification requirement isn't completed.
blockers.fix: Subscribe a working HTTPS endpoint or opt out; completing either activates the keyset.

blockers.symptom: Endpoint fails eBay's validation when saving
blockers.cause: challengeResponse is wrong, often because a hand-built string adds a byte order mark.
blockers.fix: Build the JSON with a library and hash challengeCode + verificationToken + exact endpoint URL.

blockers.symptom: invalid_grant or redirect mismatch on token exchange
blockers.cause: redirect_uri was a URL instead of the RuName, or the code expired.
blockers.fix: Pass the RuName in both requests and exchange the code immediately.

evidence.label: sourced
evidence.note: Codes reportedly last about 5 minutes (community source).

blockers.symptom: Calls fail after hitting the daily usage limit
blockers.cause: Default daily call limits (5,000/day in eBay's KB example) apply to your keyset.
blockers.fix: Reduce calls and apply for the Application Growth Check.

evidence.label: sourced
evidence.note: KB 1362 states 5,000 calls/day for the Shopping API; we assume similar defaults for Sell APIs and that limits are per keyset rather than per user.

blockers.symptom: Buy API calls rejected in production
blockers.cause: Buy APIs are a limited release for eBay partners only.
blockers.fix: Apply through eBay Partner Network, then complete compliance review and contract.

blockers.symptom: Seller must reconnect after about 18 months
blockers.cause: Refresh tokens expire (sample refresh_token_expires_in 47304000 s) and refreshing doesn't issue a new one.
blockers.fix: Track refresh-token expiry and prompt re-consent before it lapses.

nuances.text: User access tokens last about 2 hours (expires_in 7200); refresh tokens about 18 months, and refresh responses return refresh_token 'N/A' rather than rotating it.

evidence.label: sourced

nuances.text: Failure to handle deletion notifications can lead to termination of Developer Tools access or reduced API access; a false opt-out can get the account disabled.
Sandbox and production use separate keysets, endpoints and RuNames.
The Application Growth Check is free and checks API License Agreement adherence and efficient API use.
Buy API Offer access requires presenting your end-to-end flow in Sandbox, and Production access follows an Application Growth Check.
